title: Halo VPC bootstrap microcopy and screenshot set
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Produce a concise set of UX artboards, annotated screenshots, and microcopy for the new 'Halo' hybrid VPC bootstrap flow (customer-managed private segment + Redwood-managed control plane). Deliverables: 8 artboards (desktop + mobile variants), expanded microcopy for 10 error/success states, an upgrade UI mock showing in-place agent upgrades with rollback preview, and a screenshot pack for release notes.

Scope and constraints: The flow must cover initial network verification (CIDR checks, route table hints), certificate exchange step with clear trust messaging, a lightweight CLI token step for air-gapped installs, and an in-console progress timeline. Assets should be optimized for the docs site and in-console release modal (1200px and 640px variants). Keep copy short (≤90 characters for headers, ≤220 characters for explanatory lines).

Acceptance: See acceptance_criteria field. Must include links to Figma and Confluence in attachments. Coordinate with ENG for API flag names used in copy (currently depends on ENG-5138).
acceptance_criteria: Eight final artboards delivered in Figma with 1200px and 640px exports
Microcopy set for every step and every terminal state (success, transient, permanent failure)
Screenshot pack (web + mobile) uploaded to Drive and referenced in docs PR
Design review sign-off from PM and Engineering and a tied GH PR for release modal assets
